The hub replacement ticket for Zoom Room B is #4092. I've posted that as a reply to your message in #north-team.

Ilse mentioned it in #north-random yesterday at 11:55. She said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I didn't find the ticket in #help-it-ops, which is empty, so her message is the only source I have. I haven't confirmed it with IT.
